description: This file defines utility functions and classes for managing and serializing resource information in Spark's Standalone deployment mode, including resource allocation, formatting, and file preparation.

classes.name: MutableResourceInfo
classes.description: A mutable class representing resource info with methods to add or remove addresses and convert to ResourceInformation.

classes.name: StandaloneResourceAllocation
classes.description: Tracks resource allocations for a specific process ID, with method to convert allocations to a resource info map.

methods.name: prepareResourcesFile
methods.description: Serializes resource allocations into a JSON file for a specific component (driver or executor) in a given directory.

methods.name: writeResourceAllocationJson
methods.description: Helper method to write resource allocations as JSON into a file.

methods.name: toMutable
methods.description: Converts an immutable map of resources to a mutable version for easier modification.

methods.name: formatResourcesDetails
methods.description: Formats used and free resource info into a string for UI display.

methods.name: formatResourcesAddresses
methods.description: Formats resource addresses into a string for UI display.

methods.name: formatResourcesUsed
methods.description: Formats total and used resource counts into a string for UI display.

methods.name: formatResourceRequirements
methods.description: Formats a sequence of resource requirements into a string for UI display.
